name: Central Reinsurance Corporation
summary: Central Reinsurance Corporation operates both domestically in Taiwan and across international markets, providing a comprehensive suite of life and non-life insurance solutions. Its non-life offerings encompass protection against fire, marine and aviation perils, various casualty incidents, motor vehicle risks, engineering project failures, and residential earthquakes. Furthermore, the company furnishes coverage for life, personal accident, and health needs. Established in 1968, the firm maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
